issues.description: The problem statement requests: "Schreibe eine SQL-Abfrage, die die Namen aller Zoos in einer Gemeinde namens 'Erlangen' ausgibt." (problem_statement.md line 57). In the reference solution (solution_repository/aufgabe09.sql) the WHERE clause compares Gemeinde.name to the numeric literal 12345 (line 4: AND Gemeinde.name=12345) instead of comparing Gemeinde.name to the string 'Erlangen'. This mixes the conceptual use of the municipality name with a numeric key value and will cause the query to return no rows or incorrect results. Students will be confused about whether to filter by the textual Gemeinde.name or by a numeric gemeindeschluessel and which constant/value to use.
issues.suggestedFix:
Fix the reference solution to match the problem text: compare the Gemeinde.name column to the string 'Erlangen' and keep the join on the key. For example:
WHERE Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel AND Gemeinde.name = 'Erlangen'
If the original intent was to filter by a numeric municipality key instead, then the solution should compare that numeric constant to Gemeinde.schluessel (e.g. WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = 12345) and the problem statement should be adjusted to ask for that key — but do not compare Gemeinde.name to a numeric literal.
